state.unconfigured: Set a portal to get started
auto.captive: Captive portal — sign in to the network first

hint.disconnectAndPause.one: Disconnect and pause Always-On for %1 minute
hint.disconnectAndPause.other: Disconnect and pause Always-On for %1 minutes

session.dnsExplanation: Omarchy pins DNS globally, so the gateway's DNS is ignored and internal names will not resolve. Enabling installs a small polkit rule that lets this widget set the tunnel's DNS in systemd-resolved.
account.sessionStored: A portal session is stored for %1
account.hintSession: Reconnects reuse the stored portal session until it expires; Google itself stays signed in inside the sign-in window.
account.hintNoSession: Google stays signed in inside the sign-in window, so reconnecting usually needs no typing.
forget.message: Forget the stored portal session and the Google sign-in kept for this VPN?
setup.hint: Enter your company's GlobalProtect portal host, then flip the switch. Sign-in opens in its own window (Google, or a password prompt if the portal has no SSO); NetworkManager then owns the tunnel.
install.explanation: The NetworkManager OpenConnect plugin drives the tunnel. Install it once (a password prompt will appear).
portals.hint: Each portal keeps its own session, gateways, and settings from the portal. Add one in Settings.
gateways.hintFetch: Fetching signs in at the portal (the Google window may flash) and lists its gateways with priority and latency.
gateways.hintPick: Best available picks the highest priority, then the lowest latency. Click a gateway to prefer it.
host.hintOn: This is what openconnect's hipreport.sh submits when the tunnel comes up and on the portal's check interval.
host.hintOff: HIP report is off: nothing is sent to the portal. Turn it on below if your portal requires a host check.
settings.hipReportDescription: Send a host-integrity report if your portal requires one

settings.alwaysOnOnDescription.one: Connects at login and whenever the network returns; the switch pauses it for %1 minute
settings.alwaysOnOnDescription.other: Connects at login and whenever the network returns; the switch pauses it for %1 minutes

settings.alwaysOnOffDescription: Connect at login and whenever the network returns (the official client's user-logon mode)
settings.followPortalNamed: Connect method, MTU, and SSL-only come from %1 when it says so
settings.followPortalDescription: Apply the connect method, MTU, and SSL-only the portal pushes (fetched with the gateway list)
settings.sslOnlyDescription: Never use ESP over UDP; the tunnel runs over TCP 443 (slower, but survives UDP-hostile networks)
settings.blockLan: No direct access to local network
settings.blockLanDescription: Route the LAN's subnets into the tunnel while connected (the official client's setting of the same name)
settings.dnsAutoDescription: Auto: pushed domains go to the tunnel's DNS; on a full tunnel without domains, all queries do
settings.dnsSplitDescription: Split: only the pushed domains use the tunnel's DNS
settings.dnsOffDescription: Off: the resolver is left alone
settings.systemBrowserOnDescription: Sign-in opens in your default browser; the portal hands the session back through a globalprotectcallback: link
settings.systemBrowserOffDescription: Sign in inside the widget's own window (recommended). Switch on if your portal only supports the default-browser flow
settings.reportsAsDescription: The client OS sent to the portal; many portals only admit Windows and macOS. Click to cycle Windows → Linux → macOS
settings.authAutoDescription: Probe the gateway interface first, then the portal. Click to force gateway or portal
settings.authGatewayDescription: SAML at %1 on the gateway host
settings.footer: Portal: %1  ·  everything above is stored under this widget's entry in %2.

flash.signInCancelledPaused.one: Sign-in cancelled · Always-On paused for %1 minute
flash.signInCancelledPaused.other: Sign-in cancelled · Always-On paused for %1 minutes

notify.droppedBody: The GlobalProtect tunnel went down; reconnecting
notify.captiveBody: Sign in to this network first; GlobalProtect connects afterwards
